summary: Inspected the four supplied PNGs, including native 1x cells and the existing nearest-neighbor 3x panels on light, dark and checker backgrounds. The right-facing silhouette reads as a large armored scorpion: broad jade carapace with gold bands, two large two-finger pincers, six visible leg routes, and a connected segmented tail ending in a vermilion stinger. Broad upper-left highlights and darker right/underside planes give the shell, tail and pincers readable volume; gold edges remain visible on dark. Far-side legs overlap densely, but the visible sockets and limb routes remain traceable. No obvious unintended transparent holes or severed claw/tail connections were found; the openings between fingers and folded limbs read as negative space. Planted feet sit near the shared baseline while raised legs support the movement poses. Windup opens the pincers, move changes the rear/front leg stance, attack visibly closes both pincers, and recover reopens them. Hit tucks the claws; dead settles the shell and tail much lower. Skill preparation places purple at the actual stinger, the two purple discharge branches visibly originate there, and recovery folds the tail with three droplets. Poison and stun share tucked reaction anatomy but their purple beads versus gold stars and small paired claw/effect changes remain readable; sleep uses a lower resting body and folded legs, distinct from the flatter dead pose. Idle and sleep pair changes are restrained. This is an advisory visual recommendation, not the user selection. Static pose previews do not establish animation timing, dash translation, battle contact, runtime scale, palette-count compliance or literal pxgrid authorship; no geometry PASS was treated as visual approval.
